record_summary:
PLG expansion signal account. Self-serve usage started as a single-team agent-assist prototype; last 30 days shows rapid team expansion (new workspaces + org invite spike) across Support Ops + CX Engineering + Knowledge Management. Primary use case is an in-app support-agent assistant: summarize ticket threads, draft replies, retrieve KB snippets, and tag/route tickets.

Signals (PLG-to-sales):
- Team expansion signal (HIGH): 4 new workspaces created in 10 days; org invites jumped from ~3/wk to 26 in one week.
- Activation breadth (MED): new API keys created by 3 distinct admins; multiple service accounts observed.
- Reliability nudge (MED): intermittent 429s during weekday peak; not catastrophic but “annoying” per user feedback.
- Intent (MED): repeated visits to Dedicated docs + rate limiting guidance; 1 view of Security FAQ.

Current status:
- They are paid self-serve (hosted) but asking for predictable throughput and less operational babysitting as more teams onboard.
- Exploring Dedicated for peak-hour SLO stability; not currently asking for VPC/on-prem.
- CS involvement requested by Lumen: they want a single rollout plan and clear comms to avoid “random sales pings” to new admins.

Notes (AE/SE/CS):
- Quote from discovery: “We’re rolling this out to 3 squads at once, and we need it to just not fall over at 2pm when the queue spikes.”
- Workload mix:
  - 70% short-form chat completions for agent reply drafting (streaming)
  - 20% summarization jobs (async; nightly backlog processing)
  - 10% embeddings for KB search (refresh daily + ad-hoc)
- Latency/throughput targets (initial):
  - Agent UI: P95 < 900ms to first token; P95 < 4s full response for typical 250–400 output tokens
  - Summarization: throughput > latency (batch ok)
  - KB search: embedding latency “not user-facing” but wants predictable cost
- Model prefs:
  - Currently using Redwood catalog default for chat; open to smaller/faster model if quality holds.
  - Interested in routing/fallback for peak hour (cost-aware) if it doesn’t change tone too much.
- Operational constraints:
  - Wants per-workspace usage visibility + budget guardrails (chargeback to teams).
  - Asked about “shared cache across workspaces” and whether that’s safe (we should frame as org-level prefix caching w/ strict tenant isolation).
- Security:
  - Okta SSO/SAML required before broad enablement to Support org.
  - Audit logs + retention controls requested for internal compliance review.

Suggested multi-team rollout plan (CS-led, aligned w/ Sales):
1) Week 1: Lock success criteria + instrumentation
   - Define SLOs for agent UI vs async summarization.
   - Confirm evaluation prompt set + guardrail prompts.
   - Set org-level budgets per workspace; add alerting for 429s + spend spikes.
2) Week 2: Pilot with 1 team (Support Ops) + 20 agents
   - Enable streaming + structured output; establish baseline latency/cost.
   - Add Optimize recommendations: batching for summarization, caching for repeated KB snippets.
3) Week 3–4: Expand to 2 additional teams (CX Eng + KM)
   - Separate workspaces per team; consistent system prompts + shared templates.
   - Review token mix; consider Dedicated if peak-hour contention persists.
4) Dedicated decision gate:
   - Trigger if peak-hour 429s recur after caching/budget controls OR if they require guaranteed throughput for 100+ concurrent agents.

Risks / watch-outs:
- Noise/spam: they explicitly asked to avoid overlapping marketing nurture + AE outreach as new admins join. Suppress marketing lifecycle email when a sales task is open; keep a single thread owned by Avery.
- Multi-admin sprawl: multiple API keys and service accounts; need a clear “admin owner” and agreed workspace naming convention.

Internal: Signal routing + tasks
- 2025-05-27: PLG Signal created: TEAM_EXPANSION_WORKSPACE_AND_INVITE_SPIKE (score 82). Task auto-created in HubSpot and assigned to Avery (existing owner preserved).
- 2025-06-02: Suppression applied to prevent repeat task creation for 14 days unless signal score increases by +15.

Customer comms guidance (what worked so far):
- Lead with stability + rollout enablement, not upsell. Position Dedicated as an option if they want predictable peak-hour performance and clean isolation for multiple squads.

Support / CS note:
- SUP-3410 opened after an AE email reached a newly invited admin who wasn’t expecting sales outreach. Resolved with apology + clarification that outreach was triggered by team expansion and that Jasmine (CS) will be the coordination point for rollout communications.
